d:
This lively track reimagines the iconic "Jimmy Jimmy" as the groom’s anthem, where Jimmy leads his exuberant baraat, dancing joyfully at his bride Monika’s doorstep. Amid the celebration, Monika keeps calling out his name, adding excitement and urgency. Jimmy playfully urges the crowd to speed up, fearing Monika’s impatience might turn into anger. The song is a vibrant mix of love, festivity, and humor, capturing the spirited chaos of an Indian wedding
Song Credits
Track Name: Jimmy Jimmy- The Hustle Flip
Written & Performed By: Little Bhatia
Music Producer: Aditya Pushkarna
